name: Deepen the understanding of differences between sub-versions.

Using the newly purchased "Illustrated Guide to Identifying Silver Dollar Counterfeits" and online high-resolution image libraries, I conducted an in-depth study on the detailed classification of varieties:  
1. Comparing the "O" mark version: Observing the position and size differences of the "O" mark in the Jiahe pattern.  
2. Analyzing the "triangular yuan" version: Contrasting the corner shape of the last stroke of the character "圆" with that of the common version.  
3. Identifying the "Gansu version": Studying its unique font style (such as the writing of the character "年") and the rough casting characteristics.  
Beyond reading, I also practiced by sketching simple comparative diagrams of these features on draft paper, meticulously annotating key identification points such as edge serration types (straight serrations, olive serrations) and pattern details (number of grains in the Jiahe ears).

Using a smartphone macro lens and a tripod, I took multiple high-resolution photos of the front, back, and edge serrations of the suspicious coin. I then sent these photos via WeChat to my collector friend Zhao Jianguo in Xi'an, along with detailed observations and a request for his opinion. Afterwards, I searched online for key points on identifying "Yuan Datou triangular circle" coins and conducted a more in-depth comparison and study with the silver coin in my possession.

Subsequently, driven by Wu Bin, we left the urban area of Xining and headed toward Riyue Mountain along the G6 Beijing-Tibet Expressway and Zha Highway. During the journey, the altitude continued to rise, and Ye Mingxuan recorded the changes in elevation while initially assessing his body's adaptation to the high-altitude environment.
location: From Hawthorn Tree Express Hotel (Chengdong Wuyue Plaza Branch), No. 199 Bayi Road, Chengdong District, Xining City, Qinghai Province to Riyue Mountain Scenic Area, Riyue Tibetan Township, Huangyuan County, Xining City, Qinghai Province along the way

name: Sun-Moon Mountain "High Altitude Acclimatization Test" and Tour
description: During the tour of the Riyue Mountain scenic area at an altitude of approximately 3,500 meters, we walked to visit attractions such as the Riyue Pavilion and the Princess Wencheng Memorial Hall. Climbing the steps and walking against the wind on the plateau posed a significant physical challenge, which Ye Mingxuan regarded as a "natural maximum-intensity uphill test on the plateau." Throughout the process, he experienced shortness of breath and a rapid heartbeat, similar to reaching his limit in a gym, but he persevered until the end. By the conclusion of the tour, his body was nearly exhausted, and the fatigue far exceeded his expectations, serving as a severe test of his adaptability to high altitudes and the endurance of his old injuries.
location: The Riyue Mountain Scenic Area, Riyue Tibetan Township, Huangyuan County, Xining City, Qinghai Province

name: Lunch Break and Heading to Qinghai Lake
description: We had a simple meal at a Sichuan restaurant outside the Riyue Mountain scenic area to replenish our energy. Despite feeling tired and having little appetite, I forced myself to eat to ensure I had enough strength for the afternoon. After the meal, I took a short rest with my eyes closed in the car. Then, Ye Mingxuan took over the driving and continued along the Qinghai Lake Tourist Highway. As we approached Qinghai Lake, I caught my first glimpse of the deep blue lake surface, which filled me with excitement. We stopped at a safe area for about 20 minutes to take photos, getting our first taste of the breathtaking scenery of the sacred lake.
location: From a Sichuan Cuisine Restaurant in Riyue Tibetan Township, Huangyuan County, Xining City, Qinghai Province to the Scenic Viewpoints Along the Qinghai Lake Tourist Highway

name: Check into a Lake View Homestay and Explore Qinghai Lake for the First Time
description: After driving to the booked lakeside homestay and checking in, the room's balcony faced Qinghai Lake, offering an excellent view. After settling their luggage, the two walked to the lakeside for a stroll and photography. Ye Mingxuan focused on capturing scenes of the lake, flying birds, prayer flags, and other sights, while also keeping an eye out for natural textures that could be used in future woodworking videos. The continuous walking and focused photography further drained their energy, and symptoms of altitude sickness (headache, fatigue) began to become noticeable.
location: Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay near Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, and nearby lakeside public areas

name: Homestay Rest and Study Plan Interrupted
description: Due to altitude sickness and exhaustion from a full day of activities, overwhelming fatigue set in upon returning to the guesthouse room, accompanied by a persistent headache. I took some backup medication and drank plenty of water. I could barely manage basic tasks such as backing up the day's photos to the computer and sending messages to my family to let them know I was safe. The originally planned detailed travel journal and Python learning tasks were completely set aside due to severe physical exhaustion, highlighting the impact of travel fatigue on personal study plans.
location: Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, near Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, inside the room.

name: Special Tibetan Cuisine and Lakeside Sunset
description: Accompanied by travel companion Wu Bin, I went to the Tibetan restaurant recommended by the homestay owner for dinner, where the atmosphere felt like a gathering of old friends. We enjoyed specialties such as yak meat hotpot and butter tea, and our conversation expanded from the day’s experiences to our respective work and future plans, creating a pleasant social atmosphere. After the meal, the two of us walked to the lakeside to admire the magnificent sunset over Qinghai Lake. Although the social interaction was enjoyable and the scenery was breathtaking, Ye Mingxuan felt a slight internal conflict about the potential weight rebound from consuming greasy food. Additionally, while the cold evening breeze refreshed his mind, his body still felt heavy.
location: A Tibetan restaurant near the Erlangjian Scenic Area in Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, and the lakeside trail near the Erlangjian Scenic Area of Qinghai Lake.

name: Evening Rest and Bedtime
description: After returning to the guesthouse room, I freshened up briefly and had a video call with my mother, sharing the hardships and beautiful scenery of today’s journey. Due to my poor physical condition, I decisively canceled all evening study or entertainment plans. I could only browse my phone without engaging in deep thinking. Finally, I conducted a pre-sleep safety check. Amid the silence of the plateau night and the faint sound of lake waves, I went to bed early with a mix of exhaustion, pleasant social interactions, and slight regret over my lack of dietary control, ensuring my body gets sufficient rest for recovery.
location: Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, near Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Room Interior

name: Morning Awakening and State Assessment
description: Waking up in the highland homestay room by Qinghai Lake, I felt soreness all over my body and a heavy head due to the intense training and gathering from the previous day. After some simple stretching and deep breathing, I assessed my physical condition. There was no discomfort from the old injury in my right calf, so I decided to follow a low-intensity recovery plan.
location: Inside the room at Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), No. 151, National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China.

name: Breakfast synchronized with the itinerary.
description: Enjoy a light breakfast (plain porridge, eggs, and pickles) at the homestay restaurant, discuss physical conditions with fellow traveler Wu Bin, and reconfirm and adjust the itinerary for the next two days around the lake. Cancel the hiking point, increase rest time for sightseeing by car, and note the key points in the phone memo.
location: No. 151, National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch) Restaurant

name: Drive to Qinghai Lake Zhuoba Folk Culture Experience Center.
description: Wu Bin and I drove a Toyota Corolla from the homestay to the cultural experience center, enjoying the scenery of Qinghai Lake along the way. The commute took about 15 minutes, preparing for a low-intensity cultural activity.
location: Qinghai Lake Zhuoba Folk Culture Experience Center, National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Visit the Zhuo Ba Folk Culture Experience Center at Qinghai Lake
description: Visit the Tibetan Folk Culture Exhibition, focusing on the structure and mortise-and-tenon connections of traditional wooden utensils (such as butter tea barrels and saddle components). Take detailed photos to gather design inspiration for the toolbox, and engage with staff to learn about local culture.
location: No. 109 National Highway, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Qinghai Lake Zhuoba Folk Culture Experience Center

name: Return to the vicinity of the homestay and look for a lunch spot.
description: Drive from the Cultural Experience Center back to the area near Erlangjian Scenic Spot, find and choose a local restaurant called "Plateau Specialty Noodle House" for lunch, with a commute of about 15 minutes.
location: Near the Erlangjian Scenic Area in Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, there is a highland specialty noodle restaurant.

name: Lunch and Rest
description: Having lunch at the "Plateau Specialty Noodle Restaurant," Ye Mingxuan ordered tomato and egg noodles to take care of his stomach, while Wu Bin tried the firecracker noodles. After the meal, they drank tea and rested, reflecting on the experiences of the morning and preparing their energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Near the Erlangjian Scenic Area in Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, there is a noodle restaurant featuring highland specialties.

name: Return to the homestay for a brief rest.
description: Driving back from the restaurant to the homestay takes about 10 minutes. After returning to the room to drink some water, I packed the camera, stabilizer, and other equipment needed for the afternoon shoot.
location: Inside the room of Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), No. 151, National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China.

name: Learn woodworking and conceptual videos online from Master Qian.
description: Via WeChat video call with Master Qian Jianguo in Tianjin, we shared insights on traditional wooden artifacts observed at the cultural experience center, consulted on structural issues, and discussed the design of a portable earthquake-resistant toolbox for road trips. The focus was on precision control for dovetail joint connections, from which theoretical guidance was obtained. After organizing notes, the video shooting theme was clarified: "The Clash of Traditional Wisdom and Modern Engineering Thinking—From Qinghai Lake's Wooden Artifacts to My Toolbox."
location: Room inside Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Inn (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), No. 151, National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China

name: Drive to the Lakeside East Road Viewing Platform.
description: Wu Bin and I drove from the homestay to a scenic overlook on East Ring Road with a wide-open view of the lake, planning to shoot video footage. The commute took about 20 minutes.
location: A certain viewing platform on the East Ring Road of Qinghai Lake in Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province.

name: Core footage for woodworking video shooting
description: At the viewing platform on East Ring Lake Road, with Qinghai Lake as the backdrop, record an oral narration explaining the learning inspiration, film symbolic footage such as the lake waves and the rhythmic movement of prayer flags, and have Wu Bin help film the thinking process of using branches to illustrate the mortise and tenon structure. Due to poor physical condition, some shots were filmed multiple times, reflecting nonlinear progress, but the core footage was ultimately completed.
location: A certain viewing platform on the East Ring Road around the lake in Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province.

name: Return to the homestay
description: After the shoot, I drove back from the viewing platform to the homestay, a commute of about 20 minutes. I felt slightly tired physically, but my heart was full.
location: Inside the room at Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), No. 151, National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China.

name: Dinner and Free Exchange
description: Having dinner at the homestay restaurant (stir-fried vegetables and rice), chatting with Wu Bin and other self-driving tourists, sharing travel routes and experiences, and gathering practical information for the upcoming journey.
location: No. 151, National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch) Restaurant

name: Video Material Organization and Editing Attempt
description: While importing materials into the laptop in the homestay room, the Jianying app unexpectedly crashed during editing, resulting in the loss of some editing progress. Patiently restarting the software, I switched to first importing photos and short video clips to build the structure, saved the project file, and completed the preliminary sequence arrangement, demonstrating problem-solving skills.
location: In Room 151 of National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, at the Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch)

name: Video call with family in Tianjin.
description: Video calling parents Ye Jianguo and Wang Xiulan from the homestay room, sharing the scenery of Qinghai Lake, experiences at the cultural center, and souvenirs, explaining improved health and itinerary adjustments to reassure them. Mother reminded to stay warm and eat well, while father showed interest in traditional wooden structures and exchanged thoughts.
location: Inside the room of Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), No. 151, National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China.

name: Washing, tidying up, and preparing for tomorrow
description: Perform personal hygiene, soak feet in hot water to relieve soreness, organize today's shooting materials and equipment, check the battery levels of the camera, phone, and power bank, confirm the adjusted itinerary for tomorrow's lake circuit, and pack the necessary items into the backpack in advance.
location: Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), Room inside, No. 151 National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China

name: Go to bed
description: To fully recover, I turned off the lights early and went to rest. Reflecting on the day, I completed online learning and material shooting in a low-intensity manner, and dealt with the issue of the editing software crashing. Although physically tired, all planned tasks were accomplished, and I fell asleep with the calmness and satisfaction of a pragmatic person.
location: Inside the room of Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Inn (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), No. 151 National Highway 109, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China.

name: Wake up, wash up, and undergo high-altitude adaptation check.
description: Waking up under the influence of the plateau's biological clock and a reduced sense of fatigue from yesterday. Conducting a self-check on alertness: the slight headache has disappeared, and breathing is steady. Slowly getting out of bed, performing a 5-minute bedside stretch, paying special attention to the old injury on the right calf, confirming no abnormalities. After washing up, checking the weather on the phone, confirming the forecast of 'cloudy with sudden showers in the afternoon,' and placing an umbrella into the backpack.
location: Room 302, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Road of Qinghai Lake

name: Homestay Breakfast and Itinerary Check
description: Met up with fellow traveler Wu Bin for breakfast at the guesthouse's first-floor restaurant. The meal included millet porridge, steamed buns, boiled eggs, and local yak yogurt. As we ate, we spread out a map and, based on the weather forecast and vehicle conditions, finalized the departure time, route order, main viewpoints, and alternative lunch spots for tomorrow’s self-drive tour around the lake. Wu Bin shared some road condition tips he had heard from other self-driving tourists the night before.
location: First Floor Restaurant, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Road around the Lake

name: Lakeside Recovery Movement and Walking
description: Walk from the guesthouse to the lakeside viewing trail for restorative slow walking. Maintain a steady pace on the flat wooden viewing trail, strictly controlling your step frequency and breathing, with an intensity level that allows you to "hum a song easily," for approximately 30 minutes. Pause at the viewing platform during this time to perform dynamic stretches such as squats and lunges while facing the vast lake, focusing on relaxing the glutes and hamstrings that were strained from yesterday's driving and walking. Simultaneously, conduct a subjective assessment of your physical condition.
location: Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Qinghai Lake Ring Road East Scenic Trail (near Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay)

name: Return to the homestay and review the training data.
description: Walking slowly back to the guesthouse room. Drinking a large glass of warm water to replenish fluids. Connecting to the guesthouse Wi-Fi, opening the fitness app on the phone, and reviewing the fitness record chart for July in Tianjin. Focusing on analyzing the cardio training data and strength training weight curve from the week before going to Qinghai. Combining yesterday's mild altitude sickness and today's recovery, assessing that the basic cardio capacity is sufficient to support light to moderate activities at the current altitude, but maximum oxygen uptake will be reduced at high altitudes, so intense running should be avoided during tomorrow's lake loop; strength levels remain good.
location: Room 302, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Lake Road

name: Woodworking Video Editing and Rendering
description: In the homestay room, using a laptop to run the CapCut Pro version, loading the woodworking video project file saved yesterday. Frame by frame, reviewing the footage of mortise and tenon making shot at Master Qian's workshop, adjusting the lighting and contrast to ensure the wood grain details are clear. Adding concise text descriptions for key steps and selecting soothing instrumental music as the background soundtrack. After confirming everything is correct, starting to render and export the final video in 1080P 30fps MP4 format. Utilizing the rendering time to organize the luggage in the room.
location: Room 302, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Road around the Lake

name: Lunch and a Family Video Call
description: I ordered a dish of stir-fried yak meat with green peppers and rice from the homestay restaurant to be delivered to my room. While eating, I initiated a family group video call with my parents on WeChat. My parents were preparing lunch at their home in Tianjin. Ye Mingxuan turned the phone camera toward the lake view outside the window, sharing yesterday’s experiences and this morning’s lakeside stroll. His mother, Wang Xiulan, was overly concerned and bombarded him with questions about safety, diet, and health, leading to a tense conversation. His father, Ye Jianguo, tried to ease the tension, but the atmosphere remained somewhat strained. Ye Mingxuan patiently explained and provided a detailed itinerary to alleviate his mother’s worries. The call ended with his mother repeatedly reminding him to take care.
location: Room 302, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Road around the Lake

name: Uploading and Publishing Woodworking Videos
description: After the video rendering is complete, log into the Bilibili Creator Center and upload the video file. Fill in the title: '[Mechanical Engineer's Woodworking Notes] Vol.1: By Qinghai Lake, Learning Traditional Dovetail Joints from a Master Craftsman.' Add relevant tags and write the description: 'Visited Master Qian, a woodworker, during my travels and documented the process of learning traditional dovetail joints. As a mechanical engineer, this is my tribute to another form of "precision connection."' Click publish. Then, share the video link on WeChat Moments and the 'Jinmen Woodworking Friends' WeChat group.
location: Room 302, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Road around the Lake

name: Indoor Activities During Afternoon Sudden Rain
description: Outside the window, the sky suddenly darkened, and a rapid rain began to fall. Ye Mingxuan brought his laptop to the public book bar of the guesthouse. While listening to the sound of the rain, he refined the detailed route plan for tomorrow's lake circuit in OneNote, marking the GPS coordinates of each scenic spot, the estimated stay time, and photography suggestions. At the same time, he created a new note page titled "Qinghai Lake Trip - Design Inspiration," recording the wooden structure he saw in the folk museum, the inspiration from Master Qian about "tool portability and functional integration," and sketching a few simple drawings.
location: Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Erlangjian Scenic Area, East Ring Lake Road, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay Public Book Bar

name: Afternoon tea and exchange with travel companions
description: After the rain gradually subsided, I made plans with my travel companion Wu Bin to go to a nearby restaurant. We walked from the guesthouse to Junya Stir-Fried Kang Pot Meat Restaurant, which took about 15 minutes on foot. At the restaurant, we ordered a small portion of kang pot potato slices and two cups of eight-treasure tea as an afternoon snack. As we ate and chatted, Ye Mingxuan shared some anecdotes about video releases and family phone calls, while Wu Bin talked about amusing stories from his work as an IT project manager. The conversation flowed smoothly, shifting from travel photography techniques to the similarities and differences in systems thinking between mechanical engineering and software development.
location: Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Junya Stir-Fry Kangguo Meat Restaurant

name: Evening Lakeside Walk and Photography
description: The rain had completely ceased, and the sky cleared up. I took a walk with Wu Bin back to the guesthouse before heading out again. We strolled along the road toward the Erlangjian Scenic Area, capturing the magnificent post-rain scenery: cracks in the clouds allowed sunlight to pour down like holy light onto the lake and distant mountains. Using both my phone and camera for photography, it was a relaxing walk and a delightful photo session.
location: Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Road of Qinghai Lake (section from the homestay to Erlangjian Scenic Area direction)

name: Homestay Dinner and Socializing
description: Return to the homestay for dinner. In the restaurant on the first floor of the homestay, we shared a table with Wu Bin and self-driving tourists from Guangdong, exchanging travel experiences. Ye Mingxuan didn’t talk much, but when he heard that the other party’s vehicle had a slight abnormal noise, he offered several possible causes and inspection suggestions from an engineer’s perspective.
location: First Floor Restaurant, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Lake Road

name: Evening Online Activities and Travel Preparation
description: Returned to the room and checked Bilibili and WeChat. The video received over twenty likes and several comments, including recognition from friends and strangers online, which brought a sense of pleasure. Replied to some of the comments. Then, sent messages on WeChat to my gaming teammate Kai and programming study buddy Ah Ming to share updates. After that, meticulously prepared for tomorrow’s lakeside trip: checked the camera battery, cleaned the lens, filled the thermos, and packed snacks, sunscreen, rain gear, and a paper map into the backpack. Also checked the vehicle keys, vehicle registration, and driver’s license.
location: Room 302, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Road around the Lake

name: Pre-sleep washing and reading
description: Perform bedtime hygiene. Lean against the headboard and read an e-book on the history of traditional woodworking tools using a Kindle. Reflect on the day: all three core plans were successfully completed in a manner suited to the travel scenario, interspersed with rest, social interactions, and handling unexpected weather. The physical condition is good, and the mood has shifted to a sense of fulfillment and calm due to the recognition from video releases and the beautiful evening scenery. Turn off the lights around 22:00 to rest and conserve energy for tomorrow's long-distance drive around the lake.
location: Room 302, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay, Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, East Ring Road of Qinghai Lake

name: Morning Wake-up and Preparation
description: The alarm clock rang on time. Recalling the disappointing counterfeit "Guangxu Yuanbao" from last night, I rationally categorized it as a learning cost and stopped dwelling on it. I quickly washed up and changed into neat work clothes. Checked the commuter bag: work badge, notebook, power bank, car keys.
location: At home in Xiqingdao Community, No. 171 Xiqingdao, Hongqiao District, Tianjin City

name: Having breakfast with parents
description: Mother had prepared millet porridge, steamed buns, fermented bean curd, and pickles for breakfast. Father was watching the morning news. Ye Mingxuan informed his parents that he would be late coming home tonight because he needed to get his car serviced. His mother reminded him to be careful, while his father reminded him not to forget to help with the pension certification.
location: Home Chinese Restaurant, Xiqingdao Residential Area, No. 171 Xiqingdao, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Commuting to work by driving
description: Driving from home to the office takes about 40 minutes. The route passes through Xiqing Road and Outer Ring West Road, with steady traffic during the morning rush hour. While in the car, I listen to financial news and tech podcasts, contemplating the key tasks for the day.
location: From Xiqingdao Community, No. 171 Xiqingdao, Hongqiao District, Tianjin to the Office Building Parking Lot of Haitai Building, No. 6 Meiyuan Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning Work and Pension Certification
description: After arriving at the company, I parked the car and walked into the office building. I nodded in greeting to colleagues who had arrived early. Settling into my workstation, I turned on the computer, checked emails, and reviewed messages in the project group. I brewed a cup of green tea and listed the tasks to be completed in the morning. Focusing on revising the CAD drawings for the "AGV Chassis Structure Optimization" project, I adjusted local structures based on review feedback. During this time, I briefly discussed a tolerance annotation issue with my neighbor, Zhou Tao. During a work break, I logged into the "Tianjin Human Resources and Social Security" app on my phone, entered my father's information, successfully completed the facial recognition verification, and sent a screenshot to the family group chat. My father replied, "Received, thank you, son." Afterward, I continued refining the drawings and quickly checked the data from yesterday's video on my Bilibili account to prepare for a later discussion with Zhou Tao.
location: Tianjin Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. Office, Haitai Building, No. 6 Meiyuan Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Lunch, Communication, and Noon Break
description: Inviting Zhou Tao to go downstairs together, they headed to a café near the company. They ordered a light meal and coffee. Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to ask Zhou Tao for his thoughts on yesterday’s woodworking video. Zhou Tao affirmed its professionalism and suggested adding some "trial and error" processes to make it more engaging. Ye Mingxuan listened attentively and expressed his intention to try it in the future. The two also chatted about their respective project progress. After the meal, they took a walk under the shade of the trees in the square to aid digestion, while checking the hotel confirmation details for their Qinghai Lake trip on their phones. Later, they returned to the office, where Ye Mingxuan rested with his eyes closed at his workstation for 20 minutes.
location: No. 117, 1st Floor, Building H, Haitai Information Plaza, No. 6 Huatian Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, Man Coffee (Haitai Information Plaza Store) and the surrounding area of Haitai Information Plaza.

name: Afternoon collaborative work
description: A discussion was held with simulation engineer Li Xiang regarding the transmission noise issue in the project. Ye Mingxuan proposed several potential causes from the perspective of mechanical principles, and Li Xiang systematically investigated each one using simulation models. Through collaboration, they initially identified the direction of the problem and formulated a plan for the next phase of experimental testing. Afterward, they stood up to stretch, fetched water in the pantry, exchanged brief greetings with passing colleagues, and gazed out the window to alleviate fatigue. Finally, they compiled the minutes of the afternoon technical discussion and sent them via email, refined the day's work log, planned the priority tasks for the next day, tidied up the desk, and prepared to leave work.
location: No. 6 Meiyuan Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, Haitai Building Office Tower, Tianjin Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. Office and Pantry

name: Drive to the repair shop after work.
description: Driving from the company to the auto repair shop takes about 40 minutes. During the evening rush hour, the roads are quite congested.
location: From the Haitai Building Office at No. 6 Meiyuan Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin City, to the Chian Automotive Service Center at No. 15 Chenxing Road, Zhongbei Industrial Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin City.

name: Vehicle Maintenance and Car Rental Confirmation
description: Please provide a detailed explanation to the maintenance receptionist for a "comprehensive maintenance and pre-trip specialized inspection" in preparation for the upcoming long-distance self-drive trip to Qinghai Lake. Emphasize the inspection of tires, brakes, chassis, coolant, and the battery. Fill out the maintenance authorization form. While waiting in the rest area during the maintenance, use WeChat voice to have a final discussion with Chengdu travel enthusiast Wu Bin (Da Bin) to confirm all details of renting a Toyota RAV4 (model, time, insurance, high-altitude adaptability). Pay the car rental deposit online through the link sent by the other party and receive the electronic contract. After the maintenance is completed, the technician issues a report indicating that the vehicle is in good condition, with only routine maintenance performed and all inspections meeting standards, making it suitable for long-distance travel. After carefully reviewing the report data, Ye Mingxuan pays the bill by card.
location: No. 15 Chenxing Road, Zhongbei Industrial Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin, Chian Automotive Service Center Reception Area and Customer Lounge

name: Drive to the fitness center.
description: Driving from the auto repair shop to the fitness center takes about 20 minutes. Road conditions improve in the evening.
location: From Chian Automobile Service Center at No. 15, Chenxing Road, Zhongbei Industrial Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin City, to Lamei Fitness Center at No. 9, Fusheng Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin City.

name: Fitness Training
description: After changing clothes and warming up, under the guidance of Coach Wang, I completed this week's strength training plan, focusing on strengthening core and lower body strength to build physical endurance for long-distance driving. The training was rigorous and standardized.
location: No. 9 Fusheng Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, Lamei Fitness Center

name: Post-Training Relaxation and Driving Home
description: After finishing the workout, stretch and take a shower. Change clothes and drive home, which takes about 25 minutes.
location: From LIMEI Fitness Center at No. 9 Fusheng Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Xiqingdao Residential Area at No. 171 Xiqingdao Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin.

description: Mother heated up the reserved meal (braised pork, stir-fried vegetables, rice). Ye Mingxuan shared the good news that he had completed his pension certification, his vehicle maintenance went smoothly, and the car rental was finalized. After hearing this, his parents felt reassured, and his father reminded him to drive carefully on the long journey.
location: Home Restaurant in Xiqingdao Community, No. 171 Xiqingdao Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Woodworking Video Editing and Publishing
description: After a short rest following the meal, I began the video post-production work. I meticulously edited the video on the making of the "Tenon and Mortise Stool," adjusting its pacing, adding subtitles, and incorporating background music. Subsequently, I recorded the voiceover in a steady and clear tone, specifically analyzing the mechanical advantages of the tenon and mortise structure from the perspective of a mechanical engineer while explaining the production steps. After finalizing the video, I drafted the title and description and uploaded it for release on Bilibili.
location: Personal room in the home at Xiqingdao Residential Area, No. 171 Xiqingdao, Hongqiao District, Tianjin City

location: Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture / Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, along the South Ring Road (National Highway G109)

name: Return to the new accommodation point in Heimahe Town.
description: Driving back to Heimahe Town from South Ring Lake Road as the sun set, we found the booked lake-view family inn according to the navigation. Along the way, Wu Bin checked the accommodation confirmation details, while Ye Mingxuan focused on driving to ensure a safe arrival.
location: From Huanhu South Road to the XX Lake View Family Inn in Heimahe Town, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Check into a new hotel and take a walk by the lake.
date: From 17:40:00 on August 10, 2025, to 18:50:00 on August 10, 2025
description: After checking in at Lakeview Family Inn, Ye Mingxuan asked the owner about nearby locations with minimal light pollution suitable for stargazing and nighttime safety. The room’s window faced Qinghai Lake, offering an excellent view. After settling the luggage, he took a walk to the nearby lakeshore. The evening breeze was cool, and the sunset dyed the clouds purplish-red. Strolling along the pebble beach, he discussed the precise integration of the sand island’s landscape with nature (like woodworking mortise and tenon joints) and the breathability of outdoor gear fabrics.
location: Heimahe Town, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, XX Lake View Family Inn and the nearby Qinghai Lake Shore Walking Trail

name: Dinner and Itinerary Review
description: Dining at the hotel restaurant or a nearby Tibetan eatery, they ordered hand-grabbed lamb, stir-fried leaf lettuce, and noodle soup. While eating, they reviewed the day's photos. Ye Mingxuan imported the camera photos to a tablet, showcasing his slow-shutter shots of the blending sand and water, and discussed photography techniques. Wu Bin shared short video clips he had taken with his phone. The two agreed on the specific times for visiting Bird Island and Gangcha the next day, reflecting the interaction between friends and their travel planning.
location: Heimahe Town, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, XX Lake View Family Inn Restaurant or nearby Tibetan restaurant

name: Star Photography Event
description: After dark, carrying a camera, tripod, high-power flashlight, and warm clothing, they walked to a light-sheltered open area near the lakeshore close to the hotel. Ye Mingxuan set the camera to manual mode with parameters (ISO 3200, f/2.8, 20s), repeatedly attempting to focus to infinity to capture the Milky Way arch and its reflection on the lake. Wu Bin used the flashlight to illuminate the foreground mani stones. Due to the clean air of the plateau, the starry sky was brilliant, but cloud interference prevented the star trails from achieving the best effect. Afterward, they walked back to the hotel. The event reflects their passion for photography and outdoor exploration.
location: Qinghai Province, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Gonghe County, Heimahe Town, near the XX Lake View Family Inn, shaded lakeside open space

name: Evening Organization and Rest
description: After returning to the hotel, Ye Mingxuan charged all the camera batteries, cleaned the lenses with an air blower, and recorded the first day of the "Three-Day Hiking Plan" in his travel journal (approximately 3 kilometers of sandy terrain hiking, with a good physical response). He then reviewed the itinerary for the next day: the opening hours of Bird Island, the Huangyu Viewing Platform in Gangcha County, and the Tsangyang Gyatso Cultural Square. He agreed with Wu Bin to wake up at 7 a.m. the next morning and perform simple leg stretches to alleviate fatigue. Later, before bed, he read posts on the ancient coin collection forum (such as "Old Zhao's" post about the variations of "Ship Coins") and the e-book "Lonely Planet Qinghai," falling asleep to the sound of lake waves.
location: In the room of the XX Lake View Family Inn, Heimahe Town, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Watching the Sunrise at Heima River
description: Ye Mingxuan was awakened by the alarm clock, put on thick clothes, checked the camera batteries and memory cards, and then, along with Wu Bin, loaded the equipment and drove a white Toyota RAV4 to the Dawachang Ranch’s popular sunrise viewing platform. In the bitter cold, they set up the equipment, capturing the breathtaking moment as the sun leaped over the lake, and took silhouette photos of Wu Bin.
location: Dawa Ranch Internet-famous Sunrise Viewing Platform, Heimahe Town, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Breakfast and Check-out
description: Drive back to the Sunrise View Hotel at Qinghai Lake, have breakfast at the nearby Home Breakfast Shop (yak beef soup noodles, baked flatbread), then return to the hotel to pack and check out, with Ye Mingxuan checking the room for any forgotten items.
location: Heimahe Town, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Qinghai Lake Sunrise Hotel and Home Breakfast Shop

name: Self-driving to Chaka Salt Lake
date: From 07:40:00 on August 11, 2025 to 11:15:00 on August 11, 2025
description: Conduct a pre-departure vehicle inspection in the hotel parking lot, including tire pressure, lights, etc. Confirm the navigation route with Wu Bin: take National Highway G109, then switch to Gongcha Expressway to reach Chaka Salt Lake. Wu Bin drives the vehicle, and along the way, we enjoy the changing scenery from grasslands to the Gobi Desert. Ye Mingxuan monitors the vehicle's performance at high altitudes, chats with Wu Bin about the car's capabilities, and takes a brief rest for photos at the Xiangpi Mountain Pass viewing platform during the journey.
location: Starting from Heimahe Town, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, travel via National Highway G109 and the Gongcha Expressway to Chaka Town, Ulan County, Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture.

name: Lunch in Chaka Town and Preparation for the Scenic Area
description: Arriving at Chaka Town, we replenished our energy with lunch at a time-honored Sichuan restaurant (featuring boiled sliced pork in chili sauce and stir-fried seasonal vegetables). Then, we drove to the visitor center of the Chaka Salt Lake scenic area, purchased a ticket package that included a round-trip ride on the small train, and Ye Mingxuan once again checked the protective equipment for his camera.
location: Chaka Town, Ulan County, Haixi Mongolian and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, home to the time-honored Sichuan restaurant and the Chaka Salt Lake Scenic Area Visitor Center.

name: Visit the Mirror of the Sky at Chaka Salt Lake
date: From 12:30:00 on August 11, 2025, to 17:00:00 on August 11, 2025
description: Arriving at the heart of the lake by a small train, I walked barefoot into the salt lake, experiencing the cool brine and rough salt grains. I took photos of the reflections in the "Mirror of the Sky" and observed the forms of salt crystals, which reminded me of engineering materials. Walking through the salt lake, I completed the second day of the "Three-Day Light Hiking" itinerary. After the tour, I rinsed the salt stains from my legs and feet at the free washing area near the scenic spot exit, changed into clean shoes and socks, and purchased salt sculpture souvenirs. Returning to the parking lot, Ye Mingxuan checked the fuel level, volunteered to drive back, arranged the items, and replenished the drinking water.
location: Within and around the facilities of the Chaka Salt Lake Sky Mirror Scenic Area, Wulan County, Haixi Mongolian and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Self-driving back to the West Ring Road of the lake.
description: Ye Mingxuan drove the vehicle along the Gongcha Expressway and National Highway G109 directly back to the West Ring Road of Qinghai Lake, with the destination near Gangcha County. The journey took about 2.5 hours, during which he enjoyed the mountain scenery under the sunset and reflected on the experiences of the day.
location: Starting from the parking lot of the Chaka Salt Lake scenic area, take the Gongcha Expressway, National Highway G109, and the West Ring Road to reach Gangcha County in Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province.

name: Check into the lakeside west road homestay and have dinner.
description: Arriving at the Tibetan-style home stay located on West Ring Lake Road near Gangcha County, I checked in. The host offered warm butter tea, and the room was equipped with an electric blanket with a distant view of Qinghai Lake. I had dinner at the homestay's restaurant, enjoying lamb hot pot and cold mixed yak beef, and briefly exchanged travel experiences with the host and other guests.
location: Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Tibetan-style Homestay on the West Side of the Lake.

name: Evening Organization and Rest
description: Import all today's photos and videos into the laptop and external hard drive for dual backup, quickly browse and select satisfactory sunrise and salt lake photos. Briefly check with Wu Bin the general direction and distance for tomorrow's trip to Bird Island and Gangcha County, without detailed planning. Ye Mingxuan goes alone to the courtyard to gaze at the starry sky (with many clouds), takes deep breaths and stretches to relieve fatigue, then leans against the headboard browsing an antique coin collection forum on his phone, sets the alarm for 6 a.m. the next day, and turns off the light to rest.
location: In the Tibetan-style home-stay rooms and courtyard along the West Ring Road of Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Ye Mingxuan naturally woke up in the crisp air of the plateau, freshened up, and packed his belongings, including photography equipment and clothing. He then joined his friend Wu Bin for breakfast at the guesthouse restaurant, enjoying butter tea and barley pancakes. During the meal, he consulted with the guesthouse owner, Duojie, about road conditions and gathered suggestions for exploration. After breakfast, with the meticulousness of an engineer, Ye Mingxuan conducted a thorough inspection of the vehicle, checking tire pressure and the chassis to ensure a safe journey.
location: "Lakeside Pastoral Tibetan Homestay" Rooms and Restaurant, West Ring Road of the Lake, Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Self-Drive Departure and Exploration
description: Ye Mingxuan drove the white Toyota RAV4 westward along the West Ring Lake Road, while Wu Bin checked the map for side roads and admired the magnificent scenery of Qinghai Lake. Following the suggestion of the homestay owner, they turned onto an unnamed dirt road used by herders to explore unpaved terrain. Slowing down, they experienced the pristine beauty of the lakeshore.
location: Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, National Highway G315 (West Ring Road) and an unnamed pastoral dirt road near K128+500.

name: Vehicle Fault Diagnosis and Repair
description: While driving on an unpaved road, the vehicle's chassis suddenly made an unusual noise. Ye Mingxuan calmly and safely brought the car to a stop. Both of them got out to inspect the issue, and Ye Mingxuan discovered that the fixing screws of the engine underguard had become loose. Using a socket wrench from the toolbox, he tightened the screws, resolving the problem. They then continued their journey, returning to the main road along West Lake Ring Road. This incident demonstrated the hands-on skills and pragmatic attitude of an engineer.
location: An unnamed dirt road on the west side of the lake in Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, approximately 3 kilometers from the main road, with flat grassland on the roadside.

name: Heading to Bird Island and Reviewing Lunch
description: Drive to the ecological observation area parking lot near the Qinghai Lake Bird Island International Important Wetland. Have a simple lunch in the car, eating self-heating rice, pickled mustard tuber, and beef jerky. During this time, Ye Mingxuan and Wu Bin review the vehicle malfunction from the morning, analyze the cause of the vibration leading to loose screws, discuss preventive measures, and engage in technical exchange.
location: Qinghai Province, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Gangcha County, West Ring Road of Qinghai Lake, parking lot near the Qinghai Lake Bird Island International Important Wetland sign

name: Bird Watching Hiking Activity
description: In the afternoon, we took a short hike along the ecological wooden boardwalk at the edge of the wetland, covering about 5 kilometers. Ye Mingxuan used a monocular telescope to observe birds such as bar-headed geese, brown-headed gulls, and black-necked cranes, and captured a video of a flock of brown-headed gulls in flight. He adapted well to the high-altitude environment, completing his third consecutive day of light hiking while enjoying the natural scenery.
location: Qinghai Lake Bird Island International Important Wetland Peripheral Ecological Trail, West Ring Road of Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Pack up the equipment and get ready to set off.
description: After the bird-watching hike, Ye Mingxuan carefully cleaned the camera and telescope lenses, placing them in a moisture-proof case. Wu Bin gathered the trash. The two prepared to set off for Gangcha County.
location: Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, West Ring Road around the Lake, Bird Island Ecological Observation Area Parking Lot

name: Drive to Gangcha County.
description: Ye Mingxuan drove from West Ring Road around the lake, traveled approximately 75 kilometers along Provincial Highway S310, and arrived at Shaliuhe Town in Gangcha County after 1 hour and 15 minutes. The scenery along the way gradually changed from lakeside grasslands to hilly towns.
location: Within Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, from National Highway G315 to Provincial Highway S310 to the urban area of Shaliuhe Town.

name: Check into the hotel and rest.
description: Arriving at Gangcha Holy Lake Business Hotel, I checked in. The room was clean and tidy, with heating. Ye Mingxuan put down his luggage, washed his face with hot water, changed into a clean T-shirt, and stood by the window to watch the street view of the county town, taking a short rest.
location: No. 16 East Street, Shaliuhe Town, Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, "Gangcha Sacred Lake Business Hotel"

name: Local Specialty Dinner and Exchange
description: We had dinner at the "Plateau Yak Bone Soup" restaurant recommended by the hotel front desk, where we tried their signature yak bone soup and hand-grabbed lamb. The two of us reflected on today’s vehicle breakdown and bird-watching experience. Ye Mingxuan, inspired by Qinghai’s diverse culture, thought of his interest in ancient coin collecting and discussed the characteristics of coin patterns with Wu Bin.
location: No. 14 South Street, Shaliuhe Town, Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, "Plateau Yak Bone Soup" Restaurant

name: Taking a walk along the Shaliu River.
description: After dinner, the two took a leisurely stroll along the landscape trail of the Shaliu River to aid digestion, enjoying the gentle flow of the river and the sight of the setting sun casting its glow over the mountains. Upon seeing the "Huangyu Homeland" sculpture, they discussed whether they would be able to see the migrating Huangyu fish the next day.
location: Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Shaliu River Town, Shaliu River Landscape Belt Walking Path

name: Organize and back up image data
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to his hotel room, connected his laptop, and transferred the photos and videos from his camera and phone to both a portable hard drive and a cloud storage service for dual backup. He created folders such as "0812_Fault Handling," "0812_Bird Island Birdwatching," and "0812_Scenery Along the Way," adding keywords to reflect the engineer's sense of organization.
location: Room at "Gangcha Holy Lake Business Hotel", No. 16 East Main Street, Shaliuhe Town, Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China

name: Browse the collection forum and plan tomorrow's itinerary.
description: Ye Mingxuan logged into the "Ancient Coin Garden" forum to browse new posts and stay updated on the latest trends in ancient coin collecting. He then used a mapping app to communicate with Wu Bin via WeChat, planning the itinerary for the next day: visiting the Huangyu Viewing Platform in the morning, heading to the Fairy Bay Scenic Area in the afternoon, and possibly attempting to photograph the stars at night, marking alternative shooting locations.
location: No. 16 Dongda Street, Shaliuhe Town, Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, inside the "Gangcha Holy Lake Business Hotel" room

name: Relaxation Before Sleep and Bedtime
description: Ye Mingxian performed his bedtime routine, then leaned against the headboard listening to soft music while doing neck circles and waist twists to relieve muscle tension from driving and hiking. After turning off the lights, he reflected on the day's experiences, feeling a sense of accomplishment and peace from the journey, and soon fell asleep.
location: Room at "Gangcha Holy Lake Business Hotel", No. 16 Dongda Street, Shaliuhe Town, Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, China

name: Wake up, wash up, and pack your luggage.
date: From 07:30:00 on August 13, 2025 to 08:30:00 on August 13, 2025
description: Waking up naturally in the morning light of the plateau, I washed up in an orderly manner, packed all my personal belongings, photography equipment, and souvenirs into suitcases and backpacks by category, and checked out after inspecting the room.
location: Xidajie, Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Gangcha Xiadu Holiday Hotel Room

name: Taste Tibetan Morning Tea
date: From 08:30:00 on August 13, 2025, to 09:00:00 on August 13, 2025
description: Meeting up with my travel companion Wu Bin, we sampled butter tea, tsampa, and yak meat dumplings at a Tibetan tea house near the hotel, immersing ourselves in the local culture while reviewing the itinerary for the day.
location: Near West Street in Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, a Tibetan-style tea restaurant

name: Vehicle Deep Inspection and Maintenance
date: From 09:00:00 on August 13, 2025 to 10:00:00 on August 13, 2025
description: Drive to the scheduled vehicle maintenance point, explain yesterday's situation to the technician, personally check the chassis screws, suspension components, etc., and inspect tire pressure, engine oil, etc., to ensure the vehicle is in optimal condition for long-distance travel. Wu Bin is responsible for cleaning the vehicle.
location: Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Bohang Auto Maintenance Center Tires

name: Material Supplement and Procurement
description: After the vehicle inspection was completed, they drove to the supermarket for final supplies. Wu Bin purchased bottled water and snacks, while Ye Mingxuan selected practical items such as fruits and wet wipes. After settling the payment, they carefully arranged everything in the car.
location: Jialefu Shopping Supermarket, Gangcha County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Driving towards the Qilian Mountain Grasslands.
date: From 10:40:00 on August 13, 2025, to 13:00:00 on August 13, 2025
description: Leaving Gangcha and heading north along National Highway G315 and Provincial Highway S204, the scenery gradually transforms into rolling grassy hills. The two took turns driving, playing road trip music, and made a brief stop along the way to experience the gentle breeze of the grasslands and capture the silhouettes of the distant mountains.
location: The road from Gangcha County to the Qilian Mountain Grassland (near the viewing platform in Mole Town)

name: Grassland Viewing Platform Roadside Dining and Immersive Experience
date: From 13:00:00 on August 13, 2025, to 14:00:00 on August 13, 2025.
description: At the parking area of the viewing platform on the high ground of the grassland, we had a simple roadside meal, enjoying bread, fruit, beef jerky, and yak yogurt for lunch. After the meal, we moved away from the road and stood quietly, admiring the vast sky with scattered clouds and the sight of cattle and sheep grazing. We captured the beautiful scenery with cameras and drones.
location: Near Mule Town, Qilian County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, a grassland viewing platform and safe parking area.

name: Continue the journey across the grassland to Xihai Town.
description: Continue driving east along Provincial Highway S204, where the scenery is magnificent, and the straight road stretches to the horizon. During the journey, we stopped again to walk to a small slope, overlooking the panoramic view of the river valley. From an engineer's perspective, we discussed the engineering challenges of constructing a road in such terrain.
location: From the Qilian Mountain Grassland Viewing Platform to the road leading to Xihai Town, Haiyan County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture

name: Visit the Atomic City Memorial Hall
description: Upon arriving at Xihai Town, we parked our vehicle near the parking lot of the Atomic City Memorial Hall. During our visit to the memorial hall, we carefully observed the remains of the Second Sub-factory, machine tools, and other equipment. From the perspectives of mechanical structure and material craftsmanship, we gained an understanding of the manufacturing standards of that era. We were deeply moved and inspired by the wisdom and dedication of the older generation of scientific researchers.
location: Xihai Town, Haiyan County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, the Atomic City Memorial Hall and its surrounding park area

name: Drive back to Xining City.
description: With heavy yet fervent emotions, they set off on the journey back to Xining. To allow Ye Mingxuan to rest, Wu Bin took the wheel for most of the return trip. As they chatted in the car about their impressions, Ye Mingxuan remarked that with the advancement of modern tools, one should strive for even greater excellence.
location: From the Atomic City Memorial Hall in Xihai Town to a hotel in Chengxi District, Xining City, Qinghai Province.

name: Arrive in Xining and check in for dinner
description: Upon arriving in Xining City, we checked into the pre-booked hotel, completed the check-in process, and moved our luggage into the room. Afterward, we walked to a nearby noodle restaurant for dinner, ordering grilled meat and Paoza noodles to celebrate the conclusion of our journey. Following the meal, we strolled back to the hotel.
location: Chengxi District, Xining City, Qinghai Province, the reserved hotel and Ma Xiangqing Special Barbecue Noodle Restaurant.

name: Evening organization, contacting family, and rest.
description: Returning to the hotel room, I took out my clothes and hung them up, then packed the dirty laundry. I connected all electronic devices to charge and used the time to import today’s photos into the tablet for preliminary selection. After that, I sent a WeChat message to my parents to let them know I was safe and shared some photos with them. I also jotted down the key points of the day in my notebook. Finally, I completed my bedtime routine, set the alarm, and drifted off to sleep with a sense of contentment.
location: Xining City, Chengxi District, Qinghai Province, hotel room

name: Morning preparations before setting off from Xining
date: From 08:00:00 on August 14, 2025, to 10:00:00 on August 14, 2025
description: Ye Mingxuan got up early to wash up, organized his personal luggage and photography equipment, and conducted a pre-departure inspection of the SUV to ensure that tire pressure, oil, lights, and other aspects were normal. He then met up with his friend Wu Bin at the hotel restaurant for breakfast, using a mobile map to confirm the day’s route around the lake and the weather. After breakfast, they checked out of the hotel, loaded their luggage into the car, and Ye Mingxuan drove away from Xining, officially beginning their journey around the lake.
location: Qixin Hotel (Xining Haihu New District Wanda Plaza), No. 91 Wusi West Road, Chengxi District, Xining City, Qinghai Province

name: Driving around the lake in the initial stage and bird watching and photography at Sand Island.
date: From 10:00:00 on August 14, 2025, to 13:30:00 on August 14, 2025
description: Ye Mingxuan drove along the East Ring Lake Road, with Qinghai Lake gradually coming into view. Along the way, he chatted with Wu Bin about their impressions from the Atomic City Memorial Hall a few days earlier and the reliability of outdoor products. Upon reaching the observation deck near Sand Island, they stopped to watch birds. Wu Bin used a telephoto lens to capture the flocks of birds in flight, while Ye Mingxuan photographed the lake scenery and observed the steel structure of the observation deck.
location: Observation deck near the Sand Island Scenic Area, East Ring Lake Road, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Prayer and Roadside Meal at the Sutra Streamer Pass
date: From 13:30:00 on August 14, 2025 to 14:30:00 on August 14, 2025
description: Driving to a mountain pass adorned with colorful prayer flags, the wind was quite strong. Ye Mingxuan and Wu Bin took a photo together under the prayer flags, then ate a simple roadside meal in the car, consisting of pre-prepared compressed biscuits, beef jerky, bottled water, and other items, while admiring the lakeshore and distant mountain scenery. Ye Mingxuan carefully stored away the food packaging.
location: A high-altitude mountain pass (with dense prayer flags) on National Highway G109 in Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province.

name: Quiet Driving Cruise on the South Shore of the Lake
date: From 14:30:00 on August 14, 2025 to 15:30:00 on August 14, 2025
description: In the afternoon, the vehicle traveled along the southern shore section of National Highway G109, where traffic was sparse and few people were around. Ye Mingxuan slowed down and rolled down the window, allowing the fresh lake breeze to drift into the cabin. Both of them were immersed in the vastness and tranquility, while the car stereo played soothing instrumental music.
location: G109 National Highway (South Lake Section), Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province

name: Strolling and Meditating by a Non-Scenic Lakeside
description: Leaving the main road, we turned onto a small dirt path leading to the lakeside. After parking, we walked to the shore. Ye Mingxuan and Wu Bin strolled along the lake, collecting patterned stones as souvenirs. They then sat on the grass, gazing at the vast expanse of the lake in quiet contemplation, savoring the tranquility that marked the end of their journey.
location: Approximately 5 kilometers east of the Erlangjian Scenic Area on National Highway G109 in Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, there is a grassland where you can approach the lakeshore for free.

name: Drive to the lakeside homestay.
date: From 16:30:00 on August 14, 2025, to 17:15:00 on August 14, 2025
description: Setting off again, I turned from National Highway G109 onto a rural road according to the navigation, heading toward the pre-booked homestay. The road was bumpy, and Ye Mingxuan drove cautiously. After about half an hour, I arrived at the Tibetan-style Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay.
location: From G109 National Highway in Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, to the Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch) at Qinghai Lake.

name: Check in and get familiar with the homestay environment.
description: At the homestay's front desk, the enthusiastic Tibetan owner checked them in. The room was on the second floor, with a lake-view balcony. After placing their luggage, Ye Mingxuan and Wu Bin wandered around inside and outside the homestay. Ye Mingxuan checked the parking spots and asked the owner about the use of the courtyard in the evening, confirming that they could dine and relax there.
location: Near Qinghai Lake Erlangjian Scenic Area, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch)

name: Lakeside Hotpot Dinner
description: Ye Mingxuan and Wu Bin unloaded their self-prepared hot pot base and some ingredients from the car, while the homestay owner provided fresh yak meat slices and local vegetables. They set up the hot pot on a wooden table in the courtyard facing the lake, as the sun set and golden ripples shimmered across the water. Sitting around the steaming pot, they shared stories from their journey, compared the flavors of Tianjin and Qinghai hot pot, and savored the warmth of the plateau night.
location: Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Courtyard

name: Clean up dinner and back up shared photos.
date: From 19:30:00 on August 14, 2025, to 20:30:00 on August 14, 2025
description: After dinner, we cleaned up the dishes and kitchen waste together, sorting the trash for recycling. Back in the room, I connected to the Wi-Fi and transferred photos from the DSLR camera and phone to both the laptop and an external hard drive for dual backup. Ye Mingxuan selected some stunning lake views and starry sky previews to share with his family and colleague Zhou Tao in their WeChat group.
location: Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Inn (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Inside the Room

name: Deep Night Talks and Cooperation Planning Under the Starry Sky
description: As night fell, the Milky Way shone brilliantly. Ye Mingxuan and Wu Bin put on their windbreakers and sat on outdoor chairs in the courtyard of the homestay, engaging in a deep conversation under the warm glow of a light. They candidly shared their personal pressures: Ye Mingxuan spoke about the stress of the technical review for his promotion to senior engineer and the financial anxiety of meeting his parents’ expectations to buy a house in Tianjin; Wu Bin shared the challenges of supply chain management and market competition in his outdoor brand startup. Building on their mutual professional trust, they began to explore practical collaboration possibilities: Wu Bin proposed designing a groundbreaking multi-functional outdoor tool plier, while Ye Mingxuan offered key ideas from the perspectives of mechanical structure, material selection, and ergonomics, sketching a draft in his phone’s memo app. This conversation became a blueprint for future collaboration, grounded in professional respect and personal trust.
location: Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, courtyard

name: Bedtime Preparation and Bedtime
description: After the night talk, Ye Mingxuan performed his bedtime routine, charging his phone, camera batteries, and power bank, and checking the location of the car keys. After confirming the alarm for the return trip the next day, he fell into a deep sleep in the tranquil night by Qinghai Lake, bringing a perfect end to his journey around the lake.
location: Qinghai Lake Jiuxi Lakeside Inn (Erlangjian Scenic Area Branch), Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, inside the room

name: Watching the sunrise over Qinghai Lake in the early morning and checking out.
description: After waking up naturally, I watched the sunrise by Qinghai Lake with my travel companion Wu Bin, quietly reflecting on the journey as it came to an end. Afterwards, we returned to the homestay to pack our luggage, enjoyed a simple breakfast, checked out, and returned the rental car keys.
location: XX Road, Heimahe Town, Gonghe County, Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, Jiuxi Lakeside Homestay and the lakeside in front of the door

name: Self-driving return trip, returning the car, and heading to the airport.
description: Driving an SUV back from Qinghai Lake, I enjoyed the plateau scenery along the way. After arriving at the car rental location in Xining, I carefully inspected the vehicle and completed the return procedures. I then took a taxi to Xining Caojiapu International Airport, making a brief stop on the way to purchase specialties such as yak jerky and black goji berries to bring to my parents.
location: Car Rental Point at No. XX, East Kunlun Road, Chengdong District, Xining City, Qinghai Province, and the Route to the Airport

name: Airport Check-in, Lunch, and Boarding
description: At Xining Caojiabao International Airport Terminal 2, I checked in and checked my luggage. After passing through security, I had lunch at the Halal Kesair Beef Noodle Restaurant.
